# apple_beta_group_tester (Resource)

Adds a TestFlight beta tester to one beta group. Testers belong to the whole account, so this resource manages only the membership: if no tester has the email, it creates one in the group, and otherwise it adds the existing tester to the group. Destroying it removes the tester from this group only; the tester and their other groups, including other apps' groups, are left alone. To delete a tester everywhere, use the `apple_delete_beta_tester` action. Import it with `<beta_group_id>/<email or beta tester ID>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Add a tester to a group. The tester is created if no tester has the email.
resource "apple_beta_group_tester" "ann" {
  beta_group_id = apple_beta_group.public.id
  email         = "ann@example.com"
  first_name    = "Ann"
  last_name     = "Tester"
}

# Add a list of testers to a group.
resource "apple_beta_group_tester" "team" {
  for_each      = toset(["bo@example.com", "cy@example.com"])
  beta_group_id = apple_beta_group.team.id
  email         = each.key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `beta_group_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the beta group. Changing it moves the tester to another group.
- `email` (String) Email address of the tester, compared case-insensitively. Changing it adds another tester.

### Optional

- `first_name` (String) First name, used only when the tester is created. An existing tester keeps their name, and changing this argument later changes nothing in App Store Connect.
- `last_name` (String) Last name, used only when the tester is created, like `first_name`.

### Read-Only

- `beta_tester_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the tester.
- `invite_type` (String) How the tester was invited: `EMAIL` or `PUBLIC_LINK`.
- `state` (String) State of the tester's invitation, e.g. `INVITED` or `ACCEPTED`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_beta_group_tester.ann
  identity = {
    beta_group_id  = "9b3c7d1e-0f2a-4b5c-8d6e-7f8091a2b3c4"
    beta_tester_id = "4f2e1d0c-9b8a-4766-a5f4-e3d2c1b0a998"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `beta_group_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the beta group.
- `beta_tester_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the beta tester.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <beta_group_id>/<email or beta tester ID>
terraform import apple_beta_group_tester.ann 9b3c7d1e-0f2a-4b5c-8d6e-7f8091a2b3c4/ann@example.com
```
